spell.name: Arcane Imbuement
spell.description: At Apprentice: causes faint magical glow and minor resonance. Expands at higher levels to full item enchantments and multi-layer effects.
spell.notes: • Apprentice: Imbuement is faint; glow, warmth, or minor buff (+5% effect). • Novice: Item gains temporary magical property (e.g., +1 damage, +1 soak, or utility like producing light). • Master: May imbue multiple items (Multi-Target) or add layered buffs; duration extends to 1 Combat Round. • High Master: Enchantments last beyond combat (up to 1 day); effects may include scaling buffs or multiple simultaneous bonuses. • Grand Master: Creates a battlefield artifact—an item holding multiple High Master-level enchantments at once, lasting the entire encounter (or 1 day at G.O.D. discretion) but fading once resonance collapses.
spell.flavorLine: “The smallest spark of magic can become a legacy, if bound with care.”

spell.description: An ethereal vortex pulls creatures toward its center, restrains them, and distorts movement inside the zone for 1 round.
spell.notes: • Creatures in the zone make Strength/Resolve saves at the start of their turns or are pulled 10 ft toward center, knocked prone, and Immobilized for the step. • On a success, movement is halved while inside and they suffer -1 initiative. • Teleportation out of the zone requires a Resolve check; failure wastes the attempt. • Caster must pass a Focus check each round or take backlash (narrate as soul‑whiplash). • Allies are affected but gain +2 to their saves if designated by the caster. • Loose objects/spirits are drawn inward; G.O.D adjudicates collateral.
spell.flavorLine: “The soul’s tides pull all things to the deep.”

spell.description: All creatures in the area suffer –15% accuracy; those who fail a mental resistance check are Stunned for 1 step; a smaller subset (at G.O.D. discretion or on severe failure) fall into brief Temporal Stasis for 1 step.
spell.notes: * Stun and Stasis do not stack on the same creature in the same step; apply the stronger outcome. * Creatures with sleep immunity still suffer spatial distortion but may gain advantage vs. Stun. * If concentration breaks, the Cathedral collapses immediately, ending ongoing effects. * Creatures leaving the radius shed the debuff at the end of their current step. * Illusions are multi-sensory but non-damaging; they impose penalties rather than inflicting harm.
spell.flavorLine: “Sleep has walls, and tonight they stand around you.”

spell.name: Heart’s Influence
spell.description: Apprentice: minor buff to morale and resistance to fear. Expands at higher levels to AoE inspiration/dread effects and battlefield-wide emotional manipulation.
spell.notes: • Apprentice: Subtle charm grants one ally courage, providing +5% to morale-related checks and resistance against fear for 1 combat step. • Novice: Influence extends—either emboldening up to 3 allies (+1 stat or +5% rolls) or sowing dread in 1 foe (–5% to rolls, shaken confidence) for 1 combat round. • Master: Emotion spreads as an aura (AoE radius 10 ft); allies within gain +1 stat, enemies suffer –1 stat; may affect both simultaneously. • High Master: Aura scales to 30 ft and lasts 2 rounds; caster may choose to amplify unity (+10% ally rolls) or collapse enemy resolve (Stun/Daze 1 step on failed Will save). • Grand Master: A tide of resonance engulfs a vast zone (100 ft sphere, Line of Sight); allies fight with transcendent unity (+15% all rolls, immunity to fear), enemies face crushing despair (–15% rolls, potential immobilization); lingering after-effects reshape morale of armies or cities at G.O.D. discretion.
spell.flavorLine: “Every heart beats to a rhythm—this spell simply chooses the tune.”
